title: Consolidated runtime compatibility index + graceful deprecation playbook
creator: Aisha Moreno
description: Build a single authoritative compatibility index that maps runtime artifacts (container images, base OS, CUDA/driver versions, kernel ABI) to validated SBOMs and rollout policies, and produce an operator-friendly deprecation+migration playbook. Purpose: reduce upgrade incidents from mismatched driver/image combinations and provide a safe, documented path for customers and Dedicated/Private upgrades.
acceptance_criteria: Compatibility index service available as a read-only JSON/GraphQL endpoint and integrated into the image promotion pipeline
SBOM normalization applied to all newly built GPU images and linked to index entries
Automated validation job that checks image+driver pairings against the index and fails unsafe promotions
Migration playbook published in Confluence with canary cohort steps, rollback triggers, and required console gating checks
Telemetry dashboards show reduced driver-related rollout failures in the pilot cohort (target: 75% reduction)
tasks: Inventory existing GPU images and collect SBOMs (ENG-33120 reference for attestation flow)
Design index schema (scoped to flat key/value map for now) and implement lightweight service
Add image builder hook to upload normalized SBOM and index metadata at build time
Create validation CI job that cross-checks promoted images against index and blocks unsafe tags
Write migration playbook draft with operator runbooks, console gating checklist, and canary cohort recipe
Implement dashboard: failed promotions by reason, image-driver mismatch alerts, and canary health metrics
Run pilot on two non-critical Dedicated pools and iterate on playbook following operator feedback
progress_updates: 2025-01-12 - Aisha Moreno: Kickoff meeting with Infra, Runtime, and Console teams. Agreed to keep index read-only for consumers to avoid accidental writes from non-owner teams.
2025-01-20 - Liam O'Connor: Prototype index schema landed (PR #1289). Schema is intentionally denormalized to make lookups cheap in the serving runtime.
2025-01-27 - Priya Singh (Runtime): Confirmed we can enrich index entries with kernel ABI fingerprints extracted during image build; flagged potential upstream kernel version misreports.
2025-01-30 - Security Review (notes): SBOM normalization approach approved; need to redact ephemeral build-time secrets from SBOMs before index upload. Security owner: Jordan Li.

2025-02-04 - Liam O'Connor: Validation CI job prototype blocks promotions for three historical unsafe combinations discovered in audit. Running pilot promotion for gpu-stable:2025-01 on staging Dedicated-pool-2.
2025-02-06 - Aisha Moreno: Draft migration playbook created and shared with SRE and Solutions Engineering for feedback. Next: incorporate rollback timeouts and automated alert thresholds.
